body.name: \(\tau_{a,b}^r(P)\)
body.construction: \(\tau_{a,b}^r(P)=\max_{x_a,t_a}\sum_{j\in\mathcal M_a}t_{a,j}\) subject to \(x_a\in\mathcal F_{a,b}^r(P)\) and \(0\le t_{a,j}\le x_{a,j}-\ell_a\), \(t_{a,j}\le u_a-x_{a,j}\) for every \(j\in\mathcal M_a\), with value \(-\infty\) when \(\mathcal F_{a,b}^r(P)=\varnothing\)
